notes: This file is deliberately lightweight human calibration, not joint-level ground truth.
pose_family should use semantic_v3/pose_ontology_v0_1.json unless a new recurring family is genuinely needed.
Use crop_relevance to record when an exact hidden-body distinction is not important to the visible image.
human_gestalt should state the ordinary visual thrust of the image in one short phrase.

EXAMPLE_IMAGE_KEY.human_gestalt: tight seated portrait with the body slightly turned and the head supported on a fist
EXAMPLE_IMAGE_KEY.caption_proxy_notes: Do not require visible knees, feet, or a chair if the crop makes seated a reasonable ordinary explanation.
